calls.transcript: Hello, this is Officer Jordan with the Internal Revenue Service. Your federal refund is on hold due to a filing discrepancy. Please stay on the line and do not hang up. We will connect you to the refund verification department. The discrepancy involves tax year twenty twenty four and case number IRF four four two one. To release the refund we must verify the social security number on the return and confirm the deposit routing number that will receive the payment. Press one if you are the taxpayer named on the return. Have a pen ready to write the callback number eight hundred five five five zero one zero one. The refund verification department will stay with you until the hold is cleared.
